label: Updated Lex30 - listening easy-cue POS-balanced pilot v0.3
instructions: You will hear 30 English words. For each word, type up to 4 words that come to your mind. Press SPACE to go to the next word at any time, or wait 30 seconds and it will move on automatically.

selectionMetadata.cueDifficultyPolicy: All stimulus cues must be NJ8 K1 with rank <= 1000, and WordNet primary-POS counts must match the original Lex30 baseline.
selectionMetadata.selectionRule: Recommended audio candidates only; original Lex30 cues excluded; cross-list band mismatch, psycholinguistic review flags, abstract suffixes, word length, NJ8 rank, WordNet primary POS targets when requested, and stable hash used for deterministic ordering.
selectionMetadata.reviewWarning: This pilot is frozen for administration with approved audio stimuli, but it is not yet a psychometrically validated final Updated Lex30 form.
